news.title: CFTC Grants over $11M in Whistleblower Awards
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Grants over $11M in Whistleblower Awards
news.articleText: Release Number 9329-26 CFTC Grants over $11M in Whistleblower Awards November 23, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it is awarding more than $11 million to 14 whistleblowers whose original information led to the successful CFTC enforcement action against an extensive fraudulent scheme. “Today’s awardees supported an unusually challenging investigation and lawsuit,” said Raagnee Beri, director of the Whistleblower Office. “With their high-quality information and assistance, they distinguished themselves from dozens of other witnesses to the defendants’ wrongdoing.” “Each of these whistleblowers provided critical information that helped the CFTC stop the subject fraud and recover investor losses,” said David I. Miller, director of the Enforcement Division. “Their awards illustrate the value of whistleblowers in preventing and combating misconduct in the U.S. derivatives markets.” “These awards continue a record year for rewarding meritorious whistleblowers,” said Tyler Badgley, general counsel. “The CFTC is thankful for the whistleblowers who make the often-difficult choice to come forward to the CFTC with actionable information about violations of the Commodity Exchange Act.” About the CFTC’s Whistleblower Program Section 748 of the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act of 2010 established the Whistleblower Program. Since issuing its first award in 2014, the CFTC has awarded whistleblowers more than $590 million in connection with enforcement actions that resulted in more than $5.1 billion in monetary sanctions. The CFTC may issue whistleblower awards based on its own enforcement actions and related actions brought by other U.S. or foreign regulators, when certain conditions are met. The Commodity Exchange Act protects whistleblowers’ confidentiality. Whether or not the CFTC issues an award, the agency does not disclose information that could reasonably be expected to reveal a whistleblower’s identity, except in limited circumstances. Consistent with these protections, the CFTC does not disclose the specific enforcement action or the exact award amount. Eligible whistleblowers may receive between 10% and 30% of the monetary sanctions collected. Awards are paid from the CFTC’s Customer Protection Fund, which Congress established and which is funded entirely through monetary sanctions paid to the CFTC by CEA violators. The program is not funded with money taken or withheld from harmed customers. Anyone with information about potential CEA or CFTC violations may submit a tip electronically by filing an online Form TCR (Tip, Complaint, or Referral). Visit Whistleblower.gov for more information about the CFTC’s Whistleblower Program. -CFTC-

news.articleText: 'Biggest U-turn in economic history': Experts react to Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia Nvidia's board members have announced that they unanimously voted to reinstate Jensen Huang as the company's boss "effective immediately" - capping a remarkable U-turn in the technology firm's fortunes. The board had previously ruled out Huang's return after he admitted an affair with a woman who was alleged to be a Chinese spy. US President Donald Trump praised the decision, telling CNBC he made it happen, while Nvidia's share price shot up by more than 30% after a week of poor performance in the wake of the initial scandal. Experts from across the techonology and business sector reacted to his unexpected return.

news.title: Iranian authorities flog singer who performed without hijab, lawyers say
news.summary: Parastoo Ahmadi, three musicians and a producer were reportedly given 74 lashes in Qom.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Iranian authorities flog singer who performed without hijab, lawyers say
news.summaryTr: Parastoo Ahmadi, three musicians and a producer were reportedly given 74 lashes in Qom.
news.articleText: Iranian authorities flog singer who performed without hijab, lawyers say - Published A prominent singer who performed without the mandatory hijab and four members of her band and production team have been flogged by Iranian authorities, lawyers say. Parastoo Ahmadi, three musicians and a producer were each given 74 lashes in the city of Qom, a member of their defence team told the BBC. Ahmadi, 29, wore a sleeveless dress during a concert that was livestreamed in December 2024. Iran's laws ban public performances by women and require them to wear headscarves and modest clothing. This June, a criminal court in Qom convicted Ahmadi and eight others of "offending public decency" through the publication of "obscene and indecent material", which they had denied. In addition to being sentenced to 74 lashes, they were banned from audiovisual activities and from leaving the country for two years. At the end of September, an appeals court in Qom rejected the defendants' appeal and confirmed the sentence, her lawyers said. There was widespread condemnation of the sentences from other Iranian artists and human rights activists, who warned that flogging constituted cruel, inhuman and degrading punishment, and violated the international prohibition on torture. On Monday, one of the defendants' lawyers told the BBC that Ahmadi and four of her male co-defendants had been flogged at the third branch of the Criminal Sentence Enforcement Office in Qom. "We did everything in our power to have the verdict overturned, or at least to secure a reduction in the sentence or a suspension, but it didn't work out," he said. "The other lawyers and I even tried to get the enforcement of the sentence postponed, but the enforcement branch insisted on carrying it out immediately." Pro-reform daily Etemad cited another defence lawyer, Mostafa Nili, as identifying the four men flogged alongside Ahmadi as Soheil Faghih-Nasiri, Amin Taheri, Amirali Pirnia and Mohsen Lashkari. "Parastoo Ahmadi's flogging for singing and dressing as she chooses is a flagrant violation of her fundamental rights and a chilling demonstration of the Iranian authorities' determination to suppress women's freedoms and to violently punish anyone who dares to challenge their discriminatory laws and policies," said Bahar Ghandehari, director of advocacy at the US-based Center for Human Rights in Iran (CHRI). Under Iranian law, which is based on the country's interpretation of Sharia, women and girls above the age of puberty must cover their hair with a hijab and wear long, loose-fitting clothing to disguise their figures. In 2022, protests swept across the Islamic Republic following the death in custody of Mahsa Amini, a 22-year-old Kurdish woman who was detained by morality police in Tehran in September that year for allegedly wearing her hijab "improperly". Women burnt their headscarves or waved them in the air at the nationwide demonstrations against the clerical establishment, during which hundreds of people were killed in a crackdown by security forces. Since then, many women and girls have stopped covering their hair in public altogether in open defiance of the dress code. Authorities have responded with periodic waves of arrests, warnings, business closures and other measures. In January this year, thousands of people were killed and tens of thousands were arrested when security forces crushed another wave of mass anti-establishment protests, this time sparked by the country's economic crisis. Since the start of Iran's war with the US and Israel in late February, authorities have intensified their use of the death penalty against protesters. According to the Norway-based group Iran Human Rights, at least 39 men convicted over January's protests and two convicted over the 2022 unrest have been executed, along with 16 people allegedly affiliated with banned opposition groups and 17 others convicted of espionage or collaborating with foreign states. Another 121 protesters detained in January, including six women and five juvenile offenders, have been sentenced to death and are at imminent risk of execution, it says. items.articleText: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal - Published The US has said it intends to ban a Singaporean artificial intelligence (AI) company allegedly tied to the Nvidia scandal from doing business in America. The US Department of Commerce announced on Monday that it planned to add Megaspeed Ltd to a list of entities that are blacklisted from buying or selling goods in the US. The company is mainly a developer of data centres, but in recent weeks, a former executive of Megaspeed was accused of working as spy for China while having a romantic relationship with Nvidia head Jensen Huang. The relationship led to additional scrutiny by US officials and heightened concern that Megaspeed was funneling Nvidia's advanced AI computer chips to China. items.title: CFTC Staff Issues Advisory Concerning the Use of Crypto Assets to Satisfy Financial Resources Requirements
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC Staff Issues Advisory Concerning the Use of Crypto Assets to Satisfy Financial Resources Requirements
items.articleText: Release Number 9331-26 CFTC Staff Issues Advisory Concerning the Use of Crypto Assets to Satisfy Financial Resources Requirements November 23, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission's Division of Market Oversight and Division of Clearing and Risk today issued a staff advisory that explains how swap execution facilities, designated contract markets and derivatives clearing organizations may use crypto assets to meet their financial resources requirements under CFTC Regulations 37.1301, 38.1101(a) and 39.11(a)(2). The advisory recognizes that certain crypto assets, including bitcoin, ether, and payment stablecoins, may be counted toward the requirement to hold financial resources covering at least 12 months of operating costs, subject to appropriate haircuts. The advisory also indicates that because crypto assets do not count as “cash” or “highly liquid securities” under Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, they are not eligible towards the separate liquidity requirement. The advisory represents the views of staff only. It does not create new rules or enforceable rights, nor is it a no-action position and does not necessarily reflect the views of the Commission. -CFTC-

items.articleText: Bilgi fişi uygulaması kaldırıldı: Ödeme cihazlarından doğrudan e-belge dönemi başlıyor - Resmi Gazete'de yayımlanan yeni tebliğle “Bilgi Fişi” tanımı mevzuattan çıkarıldı. 1 Ocak 2027'den itibaren belirli ödeme cihazları üzerinden doğrudan e-Arşiv fatura düzenlenebilecek. Hazine ve Maliye Bakanlığı Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, elektronik belge uygulamaları ve Yeni Nesil Ödeme Kaydedici Cihazlara (YN ÖKC) ilişkin düzenlemelerde değişikliğe gitti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Vergi Usul Kanunu Genel Tebliği'nde değişiklik yapan 598 Sıra No'lu Tebliğ, Resmi Gazete'de yayımlandı. Düzenlemeyle 509 Sıra No'lu Tebliğ'de yer alan “Bilgi Fişi” tanımı ve buna bağlı uygulamalar kaldırıldı. Değişiklik kapsamında e-Ticaret işlemlerindeki e-Arşiv faturalarda, e-Biletlerde ve e-Arşiv fatura teslimatlarında kullanılan “ÖKC fatura bilgi fişi” ve “e-Bilet bilgi fişi” ibareleri de mevzuattan çıkarıldı. Böylece bilgi fişi yerine doğrudan elektronik belge düzenlenmesinin önü açıldı. 1 Ocak 2027'de doğrudan e-Arşiv fatura düzenlenebilecek Yeni düzenlemeye göre e-Arşiv Fatura uygulamasına dahil olmayan mükellefler, 1 Ocak 2027'den itibaren belirli ödeme sistemleri üzerinden doğrudan e-Arşiv Fatura düzenleyebilecek. Bu kapsamda Güvenli Mobil Ödeme ve Elektronik Belge Yönetim Sistemi, Taksi Mali Cihazlar veya izin verilen Yeni Nesil Ödeme Kaydedici Cihazlar kullanılabilecek. Sinemalarda e-Bilet zorunlu olacak Düzenlemeyle sinema işletmelerinin Yeni Nesil Ödeme Kaydedici Cihaz kullanarak e-Bilet bilgi fişi ve aylık satış raporu alma uygulamasına son verildi. Yerli ve yabancı film gösterimi yapan tüm sinema işletmeleri, giriş biletlerini doğrudan e-Bilet olarak düzenlemek zorunda olacak. Hekimlere POS cihazı muafiyeti Serbest meslek faaliyeti yürüten hekimler, diş hekimleri ve veteriner hekimler için cihaz kullanımına ilişkin kolaylık getirildi. e-Serbest Meslek Makbuzu uygulamasına dahil olan ve bu makbuzu düzenleyebilen Yeni Nesil Ödeme Kaydedici Cihazları iş yerlerinde bulunduran hekimlerin ayrıca klasik POS cihazı bulundurma ve kullanma zorunluluğu kaldırıldı. Elektronik imza yerine mali sertifika kullanılabilecek İzin verilen Yeni Nesil Ödeme Kaydedici Cihazlar üzerinden oluşturulan elektronik belgelerde, cihazın mali sertifikasıyla gerçekleştirilen elektronik imza, iş sahibinin veya yetkilisinin imzası yerine geçecek. Cihazların arızalanması veya çalınması durumunda ise bu durumun ispatlanması şartıyla tamir veya yeni cihaz temin edilene kadar kağıt belge düzenlenebilecek. Üretici ve ithalatçılara özel entegratör sorumluluğu e-Belge düzenleyebilen Yeni Nesil Ödeme Kaydedici Cihazların üretici ve ithalatçıları da yeni sorumluluklar üstlenecek. Bu şirketler; belgelerin oluşturulması, imzalanması, iletilmesi, saklanması ve yazılım gereksinimleri bakımından Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı'ndan izin alan özel entegratörlerle aynı görev ve sorumluluklara tabi olacak. Hangi elektronik belgelerin bu cihazlar üzerinden düzenlenebileceği ise Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı tarafından yayımlanacak kılavuzlarla duyurulacak.

items.titleTr: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summaryTr: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
items.articleText: Here’s what happened in crypto today Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation. Today in crypto, Nvidia shares surged Monday after its board cleared Jensen Huang to return as CEO despite an ongoing intelligence probe. Meanwhile, OKXICE began offering 24/7 trading in tokenized US securities amid pushback from major companies, and a new analysis raised questions about foreign participation in US President Donald Trump’s second memecoin dinner. Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO amid ongoing intelligence probe Nvidia’s board unanimously voted to reinstate Jensen Huang as president and CEO after consultations with senior US government officials, concluding that his return posed no national security risk despite an ongoing investigation into an alleged foreign intelligence operation targeting him. In a Monday announcement, Nvidia said its directors were satisfied with Huang’s candor and ability to lead following a series of discussions. The independent investigation will continue despite his reinstatement. Nvidia shares surged 28.91% to $161.82 shortly after US markets opened on Monday, according to Yahoo Finance data. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress, who served as interim CEO, will return to her previous role, while Harvey Jones will remain chair of the board. The chipmaker also said it had recently formed a National Security and Export Control Committee comprising independent directors to oversee compliance and security risks. Nvidia plans to appoint a chief compliance officer and said it would continue cooperating with government investigations. OKX, ICE launch 113 tokenized assets despite issuer objections OKXICE, a joint venture between cryptocurrency exchange OKX and New York Stock Exchange parent Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), launched a venue Monday for round-the-clock trading of tokenized US securities, with 113 assets set to roll out in stages. The lineup includes stocks, exchange-traded funds and other exchange-traded products, according to an announcement shared with Cointelegraph. OKXICE named Coinbase, Circle, Fidelity Investments and Robinhood among the issuers and asset managers taking part. Before the launch, 67 companies, including Meta, Tesla and Netflix, sought to keep tokenized versions of their shares off the venue. Each token represents a security entitlement backed one-to-one by an underlying share, OKXICE said. Holders are entitled to dividends and voting rights where applicable. OKXICE said the venue operates under the US Securities and Exchange Commission’s Innovation Exemption. Access is limited to eligible US customers of OKX Inc., who must verify their identity, activate a self-custodial wallet and complete onboarding before trading through the OKX app. Half of wallets on Trump’s dinner list got tokens from non-US exchanges More than half the wallets that qualified for Donald Trump’s memecoin dinner on Sunday received TRUMP tokens from crypto exchanges that bar US users, according to analysis from consumer advocacy group Public Citizen. Trump is hosting his second dinner for his top memecoin holders at Trump National Golf Club in Sterling, Virginia, more than a year after an inaugural dinner in May 2025. The dinner offers up to 185 seats based on time-weighted TRUMP holdings. Public Citizen said it traced 66 of the 130 wallets on the public leaderboard to exchanges including Binance (the global exchange), Bybit and BloFin — which are not permitted to serve US citizens. The list also included 15 of the 29 wallets that qualified for a VIP reception with the president. “If those bans are enforced, many of the people vying for a seat at the president’s table don’t live in the United States,” said Public Citizen research director Zach Everson. Trump’s memecoin events have drawn scrutiny over whether foreign buyers can essentially buy access to the president. Democratic lawmakers called on the White House to release the guest list for the first dinner in May 2025, while some joined a protest outside the golf club. They renewed the request again in October.

items.articleText: Resmi Gazete'de yayımlandı: Yeniden değerleme oranı belli oldu - Hazine ve Maliye Bakanlığı, 2026 yılı yeniden değerleme oranını yüzde 27,83 olarak belirledi. Oran, yılın son geçici vergi döneminde de uygulanacak. 2026 yılı yeniden değerleme oranı yüzde 27,83 olarak tespit edildi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Hazine ve Maliye Bakanlığı Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı tarafından hazırlanan Vergi Usul Kanunu Genel Tebliği, Resmi Gazete'de yayımlandı. Tebliğe göre, 2026 yılı için yeniden değerleme oranı yüzde 27,83 olarak belirlendi. Söz konusu oran, 2026 yılının son geçici vergi döneminde de uygulanacak. Konuya ilişkin daha önce yayımlanan tebliğlerin yürürlükte kalacağı bildirildi. Yeniden değerleme oranı nasıl belirleniyor? Vergi Usul Kanunu uyarınca yeniden değerleme oranı, yeniden değerlemenin yapılacağı yılın ekim ayı dahil olmak üzere önceki yılın aynı dönemine göre Yurt İçi Üretici Fiyat Endeksi'nde (Yİ-ÜFE) meydana gelen ortalama fiyat artışı esas alınarak hesaplanıyor. Hazine ve Maliye Bakanlığı tarafından belirlenen oran, Resmi Gazete'de ilan ediliyor.

items.title: Nvidia value climbs by almost $1tn and tech stocks rally after Jensen Huang returns
items.summary: The jump in Nvidia shares has also lifted stock markets, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq up 6.5%.

items.titleTr: Nvidia value climbs by almost $1tn and tech stocks rally after Jensen Huang returns
items.summaryTr: The jump in Nvidia shares has also lifted stock markets, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq up 6.5%.
items.articleText: Nvidia value climbs by almost $1tn and tech stocks rally after Jensen Huang returns - Published Nvidia's market value rose by nearly $1 trillion as its share price skyrocketed after the tech firm reinstated Jensen Huang as its chief executive with immediate effect. His shock reinstatement comes less than two weeks after Huang resigned after admitting an affair with a woman who was alleged to be a Chinese spy, a period in which shares in the chipmaker have also fallen significantly. Nvidia shares rose by more than 31% which also lifted stock markets, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq climbing by 6.5% and the S&P 500 also rose 4.75%. Tech stocks more broadly have also rallied following large falls on Friday, with much of the rally starting in pre-market trading before Huang's return was announced. Other chipmakers experienced large increases following Monday's announcement from the Nvidia board. Shares in Micron Technology jumped 19%, while AMD shares rose nearly 7%. Tesla shares also lept up by nearly 11.5%, while other tech gains were more muted by comparison: Amazon shares were up nearly 3.5%, and Apple and Microsoft rose by less than 2%. While the surge in Nvidia shares was large and drove its market value back towards $4tn, the firm's share price remains about 21% down from a month ago. A sharp drop occurred on 4 November, after the Democrat's midterm election victory sparked fears of tougher AI regulation to come led to a broad tech stock sell-off. On Friday alone, Nvidia shares fell by 13.7% as tech stocks more broadly fell, and as Reuters reported - unconfirmed by the BBC - that the company was being investigated by the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) over its accounting practices. Nvidia is a key firm at the core of the artificial intelligence (AI) boom, with the chips it makes central to the industry. Nvidia's board of directors voted unanimously to reinstate the firm's co-founder following "a series of discussions and meetings" with him, the company said - but US President Donald Trump has claimed he "convinced" the board to reinstate Huang. Kathleen Brooks, research director at brokerage firm XTB, said Huang's return showed Huang was the "godfather" of AI, and "has a talismanic influence over the sector". "Barely two weeks ago this man was ousted from the company that he founded due to serious misconduct and potential national security issues," she said. "Even though Huang did not hold special voting shares on the board, Nvidia's directors cannot see a future for the company without him." Dan Coatsworth, head of markets at AJ Bell, said Huang's reinstatement was an astonishing about-turn for Nvidia, particularly given reports of an as-yet unconfirmed SEC investigation. "This is the biggest corporate U-turn in living memory. To go from being embroiled in a spy scandal to being reinstated as the head of one of the world's most valuable companies in less than a fortnight is nothing short of remarkable," he said. "Today's stock market rebound represents a massive sigh of relief by investors. However, one cannot rule out a more conservative approach by Huang going forward. "His every move will be scrutinised by the market, and he may wish to tread more carefully to protect his integrity and ensure that Nvidia is being run responsibly." Politicians are also demanding greater scrutiny. Senator Jeanne Shaheen, the top Democrat on the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, said Huang's reinstatement "reportedly at the encouragement of Trump Administration officials and without any apparent accounting or response to the risks to our national security, demands an explanation." She added: "What is abundantly clear is that the AI industry requires guardrails and oversight." Related topics - Published6 hours ago - Published3 hours ago - Published6 hours ago

items.summaryTr: ABD'de tüketici harcamaları yüksek enflasyona rağmen güçlü kalmayı sürdürüyor. Piyasa uzmanı Scott Feiler, Black Friday döneminde perakende satışlarının hızlanmasını beklerken seyahat ve otel sektöründeki güçlü talebe dikkat çekti.
items.articleText: Tüketici enflasyona direniyor: Black Friday öncesi perakende rallisi beklentisi - ABD'de tüketici harcamaları yüksek enflasyona rağmen güçlü kalmayı sürdürüyor. Piyasa uzmanı Scott Feiler, Black Friday döneminde perakende satışlarının hızlanmasını beklerken seyahat ve otel sektöründeki güçlü talebe dikkat çekti. ABD'de yüksek enflasyon ve fiyat baskılarına rağmen tüketici harcamaları dirençli seyrini koruyor. Black Friday öncesinde perakende sektörüne ilişkin beklentiler de güçleniyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Tüketici sektörü uzmanı Scott Feiler, ABD'de tüketicinin ekonomik koşullara rağmen harcamalarını sürdürdüğünü belirtti. Ekim ayı perakende satışlarının beklentileri aştığını, eylül ayı verisinin de yukarı yönlü revize edildiğini hatırlatan Feiler, şirketlerden gelen açıklamaların tüketici talebinin güçlü kaldığına işaret ettiğini söyledi. Feiler, haftalık işsizlik maaşı başvurularının yaklaşık 200 bin seviyesinde bulunduğunu ve ücret artışlarının güçlü seyrini koruduğunu belirtti. Benzin fiyatlarının zirve seviyelerinden gerilemesinin de tüketici harcamalarını desteklediğini ifade etti. Black Friday öncesi perakende hisselerinde yükseliş beklentisi Feiler, ABD'de perakende sektörünün kasım ayında tarihsel olarak güçlü performans gösterdiğine dikkat çekti. Son 10 kasım ayının 9'unda perakende sektörünün genel piyasadan daha iyi performans sergilediğini belirten Feiler, bu yükselişin önemli bölümünün Black Friday dönemine denk gelen son iki haftada gerçekleştiğini söyledi. Feiler, dördüncü çeyreğin şu ana kadarki performansının üçüncü çeyreğin son dönemine kıyasla daha güçlü olduğunu belirterek perakende sektöründeki olumlu seyrin gelecek hafta da devam etmesini beklediğini kaydetti. Seyahat ve otel harcamaları öne çıkıyor ABD'li tüketicilerin yalnızca perakende ürünlerine değil, seyahat ve deneyimlere de harcama yapmayı sürdürdüğünü belirten Feiler, seyahat sektörü hisselerinin son bir ayda yaklaşık yüzde 10 yükseldiğini söyledi. Otel sektöründe oda başına gelir göstergesinin (RevPAR) güçlü seyrettiğini, kruvaziyer şirketlerinden gelen açıklamaların da olumlu olduğunu aktardı. Feiler, tüketicilerin deneyim odaklı harcamalarını sürdürdüğünü belirterek otel ve kruvaziyer sektörlerinin güçlü talep görünümünden yararlandığını ifade etti. 2027'de şirketlerin kâr marjları baskılanabilir Tüketici talebindeki dayanıklılığa rağmen şirketleri gelecek yıl maliyet baskılarının beklediği uyarısı yapıldı. Feiler, hammadde ve navlun maliyetlerinin 2027'de şirketlerin kâr marjları üzerinde baskı oluşturabileceğini belirtti. Şirketlerin artan maliyetleri tüketicilere yansıtmasının da fiyatlama gücüne bağlı olacağını ifade etti. Bu nedenle şirketler arasında önemli bir ayrışma yaşanabileceğini belirten Feiler, maliyet artışlarını tüketiciye aktarabilen şirketlerin rakiplerine kıyasla daha avantajlı olabileceğine işaret etti.

items.title: CFTC Publishes Final Rule Concerning Data Reporting Requirements for Certain Event Contracts
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC Publishes Final Rule Concerning Data Reporting Requirements for Certain Event Contracts
items.articleText: Release Number 9330-26 CFTC Publishes Final Rule Concerning Data Reporting Requirements for Certain Event Contracts November 23, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced approval of a final rule regarding amendments to Part 15, Part 16, and Part 17 of the Commission’s regulations. The final rule sets forth an alternate framework for the reporting of data in connection with certain fully collateralized event contracts, which have been the subject of staff no-action letters since 2017. These revisions require certain reporting markets, futures commission merchants, clearing members, and foreign brokers to report certain event contracts pursuant to the regulations in Parts 15 through 18 rather than the reporting regulations contained in certain sections of Parts 38, 39, 43 and 45. “The CFTC will no longer regulate market participants through a patchwork of no-action letters, which serve as band-aids for unworkable regulations. This final rule is an important step in future-proofing the regulatory framework for event contracts,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “The Commission’s responsibility is to provide clear, workable regulations, and I’m committed to doing just that for all markets we regulate.” The final rule adds a new section 16.03, titled “Covered Event Contracts” to Part 16, concerning “Reports by Contract Markets and Swap Execution Facilities.” The proposal specifically provides for reporting pursuant to Sections 16.00, 16.01, Part 17, and Part 18 of the Commission regulations. The final rule sets the following compliance dates: - For Sections 16.03(a), (b)(2), (b)(3), and (f), the compliance date is 60 days following publication of the final rule in the Federal Register. - For Sections 16.03(b)(1), (c), (d), and (e), the compliance date is the later of either (a) 60 days following publication of this final rule in the Federal Register or (b) July 26, 2027. - For Section 16.03(g), the compliance date is 12 months following publication of this final rule in the Federal Register. In connection with the final rule, the Division of Data is publishing a guidebook pursuant to Section 16.02 that specifies the content, as well as the time for submission and form and manner, for designated contract markets to submit trader-identifying information, including that required to be collected under Section 16.03(g), to the Commission. Additionally, the guidebook specifies the form and manner for submitting information related to the settlement of covered event contracts as required by Section 16.03(b)(2). The guidebook is available here. -CFTC-

items.title: What strike on Russian ship in Libya says about spread of Ukraine war
items.summary: Ukraine's sinking of a Russian battleship at a port in Libya raises the stakes of the war a notch, writes Frank Gardner.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: What strike on Russian ship in Libya says about spread of Ukraine war
items.summaryTr: Ukraine's sinking of a Russian battleship at a port in Libya raises the stakes of the war a notch, writes Frank Gardner.
items.articleText: What strike on Russian ship in Libya says about spread of Ukraine war - Published Anchored in a Mediterranean harbour nearly 2,000 miles from Moscow, the Captain of Russia's corvette Merkury might well have thought his ship was safe from attack. It wasn't. The audacious and successful night-time attack in Benghazi, co-ordinated by Ukraine's SBU intelligence agency and its armed forces, has raised the obvious question: is the Ukraine war spreading well beyond its borders? The answer is yes, in fact, it was already spreading. But this attack, which Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky called "an exemplary operation" will inevitably raise the stakes another notch. Russia, which is currently engaged in a non-stop campaign to batter Ukraine's civilian population into submission with daily missile and drone strikes, has called it "a dangerous escalation". It follows the suspected Ukrainian drone attack on a Russian dry-cargo ship in the Gulf of Finland at the weekend, which the Kremlin described as an act of terrorism. Ukraine's long-range drones have also previously struck Russia's Baltic oil terminal at Ust-Luga. Some of Ukraine's more audacious long-range drone attacks – what Zelensky likes to call "long-range sanctions" – have also struck targets thousands of kilometres beyond Ukraine's borders with Russia, deep inside Siberia. The most notable of these was last year's Operation Spider's Web, which involved a specially adapted lorry that drove close to a Russian strategic nuclear bomber airbase and released a "swarm" of explosive drones that damaged or destroyed several expensive bombers. And Ukraine has also been active further south in Africa where its forces have targeted Russian mercenaries from the Africa Corps, the successor to the infamous Wagner Group that was accused of carrying out numerous human rights abuses. It's not just Russia that will be alarmed by this latest Ukrainian operation in Benghazi harbour. The United Nations mission in Libya has already expressed its "deep concern". Libyan officials point out that their country is not a party to the Russia-Ukraine war, although the Merkury and an accompanying cargo ship that was also hit were berthed in the eastern part of Libya controlled by the pro-Moscow warlord and self-styled "Field Marshal" Khalifa Haftar. Throughout this year the International Maritime Organisation (IMO) has condemned all attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and today the global shipping community will be wondering whether this attack does indeed set a dangerous precedent. If Ukraine can plan and execute such a bold attack on Russian ships in a nominally neutral harbour so far from home, where does this stop? Impact elsewhere in Europe As the fifth anniversary of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine approaches, this war has already been spreading, notably in other parts of Europe. On Friday, several Russian projectiles landed well inside Poland's borders, just 60 miles from an Anglo-French exercise of forces intended to be deployed following an eventual ceasefire in Ukraine. This, said Poland's PM Donald Tusk, was "a deliberate provocation" by Moscow. It's not the first time Russian munitions have landed inside Poland, and therefore inside Nato territory, but observers have pointed out that Russia's probing of Nato's borders is becoming ever more brazen and some are calling for a firmer response. But Russia is already heavily sanctioned by the West, with Europe having reduced much – but not all – of its energy imports from Russia, so the options for retaliation are limited, short of military confrontation, which no one wants. Both Romania and Moldova have found themselves frequently struck by overflying Russian drones targeting Ukraine's Black Sea ports, while Bulgaria and Romania have suffered maritime drone attacks on commercial shipping just offshore in the Black Sea. In the case of Romania, a Nato member, fast jets have had to be scrambled to intercept incoming Russian drones and there is a profound suspicion that these incursions are not all accidental. The three Baltic states – Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania – all have borders with Russia and all consider themselves right on the front lines in this war. There have been a number of anonymous attacks on military industrial facilities in these countries, blamed on agents acting on Moscow's behalf. Russia, for its part, suspects Estonia of being complicit in Ukrainian drone attacks on the Baltic involving overflights through Estonian airspace. Hybrid attacks Hybrid warfare isn't new but it is on the rise. It refers to the practice, by either side, of carrying out largely anonymous and unattributable operations using methods like cyber attacks, the burning down of warehouses supplying military equipment and the dispatching of drones, both for surveillance and loaded with explosives. This autumn, Germany's Leipzig-Halle airport, which is used as a resupply hub by Ukraine's cargo aircraft, was targeted by three explosive drones that were discovered before anyone was hurt. There have been other incidents involving explosive packages sent across Europe targeting Germany, Poland and the UK. Moscow denies any involvement.

items.articleText: ABD'den Binance'e 1,1 milyar dolarlık dava: Kripto varlıklar hedefte! - ABD Adalet Bakanlığı, Kuzey Koreli siber aktörlerin Binance'den yasa dışı yollarla elde ettiği 1,1 milyar doların üzerindeki USDC varlığına el konulması talebiyle dava açtı. Söz konusu varlıklar daha önce dondurulmuştu. ABD Adalet Bakanlığı, Kuzey Koreli siber aktörlerin Binance'den yasa dışı yollarla elde ettiği 1,1 milyar doların üzerindeki kripto para varlığına el konulması amacıyla dava açtı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Bakanlıktan yapılan açıklamada, davanın Binance'den gerçekleştirilen ve 6 milyar doları aşan hırsızlık kaynaklı varlıkların geri kazanılmasına yönelik daha kapsamlı hükümet çalışmalarının bir parçası olduğu belirtildi. Dava kapsamında, hırsızlık sonrası aklanan fonları temsil ettiği belirtilen, Circle Internet Financial tarafından ihraç edilen USDC cinsinden 1,1 milyar doların üzerindeki varlığın müsaderesi talep edildi. Söz konusu varlıklar daha önce dondurulmuştu ABD Adalet Bakanlığı, söz konusu kripto varlıkların hırsızlığın ardından hükümetin talebi üzerine çıkarılan bir tedbir kararı kapsamında daha önce dondurulduğunu bildirdi. Açıklamada ayrıca ABD'nin, 29 Ekim'de Binance'den gerçekleştirilen hırsızlık olayından bu yana farklı kaynaklardan toplam 2,9 milyar doların üzerindeki kripto para varlığının dondurulmasına, el konulmasına veya iade edilmesine yardımcı olduğu kaydedildi. 6 milyar doları aşan varlıkların geri kazanılması hedefleniyor Bakanlığın açıklamasına göre son dava, Binance'den çalınan 6 milyar doların üzerindeki varlığın geri kazanılmasına yönelik daha geniş kapsamlı çalışmaların parçası olarak yürütülüyor.

Açıklamada ayrıca ABD'nin, 29 Ekim'de Binance'den gerçekleştirilen hırsızlık olayından bu yana farklı kaynaklardan toplam 2,9 milyar doların üzerindeki kripto para varlığının dondurulmasına, el konulmasına veya iade edilmesine yardımcı olduğu kaydedildi. 6 milyar doları aşan varlıkların geri kazanılması hedefleniyor Bakanlığın açıklamasına göre son dava, Binance'den çalınan 6 milyar doların üzerindeki varlığın geri kazanılmasına yönelik daha geniş kapsamlı çalışmaların parçası olarak yürütülüyor.

items.articleText: Dev kurumdan ABD bankaları için 2027 uyarısı: Sektör görünümü kötüleşiyor! - Fitch Ratings, yüksek faizler, artan fonlama maliyetleri ve kredi risklerindeki yükseliş nedeniyle ABD bankacılık sektörünün 2027 görünümünü “nötr”den “kötüleşiyor”a indirdi. Buna rağmen bankaların finansal göstergelerinin tarihsel ortalamalara göre güçlü kalması bekleniyor. Uluslararası kredi derecelendirme kuruluşu Fitch Ratings, ABD bankacılık sektörünün 2027 görünümünü aşağı yönlü revize etti. Kuruluş, sektörün görünümünü “nötr” seviyesinden “kötüleşiyor” seviyesine çekti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Fitch'in değerlendirmesine göre kalıcı enflasyon ve ekonomik faaliyetlerin dirençli seyri, faiz oranlarının daha uzun süre yüksek kalmasına neden olabilir. Mevduat toplama rekabetinin de fonlama maliyetlerini artırarak bankaların kârlılığını baskılaması bekleniyor. Net faiz gelirlerinin bankacılık sektörünü desteklemeyi sürdürmesi öngörülürken, gelir artışındaki normalleşme ve yükselen kredi maliyetlerinin kârlılık üzerinde baskı oluşturacağı belirtiliyor. Ticari gayrimenkul kredilerinde risk artıyor Fitch, özellikle yüksek borçlanma maliyetleri ve yeniden finansman baskılarının kredi risklerini artırdığına dikkat çekti. Yüksek kaldıraçlı borçluların bulunduğu ticari gayrimenkul ve diğer ticari kredi portföylerinde bozulma yaşanabileceği öngörülüyor. Banka dışı finansal kuruluşlara verilen krediler ile yapay zeka ve veri merkezi finansmanına yönelik artan risklerin de piyasa düzeltmelerine ve varlık fiyatlarındaki düşüşlere karşı hassasiyeti artırabileceği ifade ediliyor. Düzenlemelerin gevşemesi sermaye tamponlarını azaltabilir Fitch, düzenlemelerde beklenen gevşemenin bankaların sermaye kullanımını ve bilanço büyümesini destekleyebileceğini belirtti. Ancak daha düşük sermaye gerekliliklerinin, bankaların yasal asgari seviyelerin üzerindeki sermaye tamponlarını azaltabileceği uyarısı yapıldı. Kredi koşullarının zayıflaması veya siber risklerin artması durumunda bu gelişmenin bankaların beklenmedik kayıpları karşılama kapasitesini sınırlayabileceği kaydedildi. Bankaların finansal göstergeleri güçlü kalabilir Olumsuz görünüm revizyonuna rağmen Fitch, ABD bankalarının çoğunun finansal göstergelerinin tarihsel standartlara göre sağlam kalmasını bekliyor. Kuruluş, görünümdeki değişikliğin bankaların 2026'da rekor düzeyde kâr elde etmesinin ve aktif kalitesinin genel olarak güçlü seyretmesinin ardından geldiğine işaret etti. Bu durumun bankalara kredi koşullarında yaşanabilecek ılımlı bozulmaları karşılayabilecek kapasite sağladığı belirtildi. Bankaların çoğunun kredi notu görünümünün ise “durağan” seviyesini koruduğu bildirildi. Fitch, kredi koşullarındaki bozulmanın sınırlı kalması, kârlılığın istikrarını koruması ve sermaye tamponlarındaki azalmanın düşük seviyede gerçekleşmesi halinde sektör görünümünün yeniden “nötr”e yükseltilebileceğini kaydetti.

items.articleText: Pendik'te 40 gün sürecek trafik düzenlemesi: İki şerit kapatılıyor YAYIN TARİHİ, 23 Kasım 2026 22:24 PAYLAŞ - İstanbul Pendik'teki Tersane Köprüsü'nde gerçekleştirilecek güçlendirme çalışmaları nedeniyle trafik akışında geçici düzenlemeye gidilecek. Köprünün sahil yönündeki iki şeridi, 40 gün boyunca gece saatlerinde araç geçişine kapatılacak. İstanbul Büyükşehir Belediyesi (İBB), Pendik Tersane Köprüsü'nde bakım ve güçlendirme çalışmalarının başlayacağını duyurdu. Çalışmalar kapsamında köprünün genleşme derzleri yenilenecek. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Sabiha Gökçen Havalimanı yönünden sahil istikametine giden iki şerit, 23 Kasım'dan itibaren 40 gün boyunca belirli saatlerde trafiğe kapalı olacak. Gece 22.00 ile 06.00 arasında kapalı olacak İBB'nin açıklamasına göre çalışmalar, trafik yoğunluğunun daha düşük olduğu 22.00-06.00 saatleri arasında gerçekleştirilecek. Köprünün sahil yönündeki iki şeridi, çalışmaların sürdüğü gece saatlerinde araç trafiğine kapatılırken, 06.00'dan itibaren yeniden ulaşıma açılacak. Trafik düzenlemesinin 40 günlük çalışma süresince devam etmesi planlanıyor. Kaynak: AA

items.title: CFTC Grants over $11M in Whistleblower Awards
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC Grants over $11M in Whistleblower Awards
items.articleText: Release Number 9329-26 CFTC Grants over $11M in Whistleblower Awards November 23, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it is awarding more than $11 million to 14 whistleblowers whose original information led to the successful CFTC enforcement action against an extensive fraudulent scheme. “Today’s awardees supported an unusually challenging investigation and lawsuit,” said Raagnee Beri, director of the Whistleblower Office. “With their high-quality information and assistance, they distinguished themselves from dozens of other witnesses to the defendants’ wrongdoing.” “Each of these whistleblowers provided critical information that helped the CFTC stop the subject fraud and recover investor losses,” said David I. Miller, director of the Enforcement Division. “Their awards illustrate the value of whistleblowers in preventing and combating misconduct in the U.S. derivatives markets.” “These awards continue a record year for rewarding meritorious whistleblowers,” said Tyler Badgley, general counsel. “The CFTC is thankful for the whistleblowers who make the often-difficult choice to come forward to the CFTC with actionable information about violations of the Commodity Exchange Act.” About the CFTC’s Whistleblower Program Section 748 of the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act of 2010 established the Whistleblower Program. Since issuing its first award in 2014, the CFTC has awarded whistleblowers more than $590 million in connection with enforcement actions that resulted in more than $5.1 billion in monetary sanctions. The CFTC may issue whistleblower awards based on its own enforcement actions and related actions brought by other U.S. or foreign regulators, when certain conditions are met. The Commodity Exchange Act protects whistleblowers’ confidentiality. Whether or not the CFTC issues an award, the agency does not disclose information that could reasonably be expected to reveal a whistleblower’s identity, except in limited circumstances. Consistent with these protections, the CFTC does not disclose the specific enforcement action or the exact award amount. Eligible whistleblowers may receive between 10% and 30% of the monetary sanctions collected. Awards are paid from the CFTC’s Customer Protection Fund, which Congress established and which is funded entirely through monetary sanctions paid to the CFTC by CEA violators. The program is not funded with money taken or withheld from harmed customers. Anyone with information about potential CEA or CFTC violations may submit a tip electronically by filing an online Form TCR (Tip, Complaint, or Referral). Visit Whistleblower.gov for more information about the CFTC’s Whistleblower Program. -CFTC-

The CFTC may issue whistleblower awards based on its own enforcement actions and related actions brought by other U.S. or foreign regulators, when certain conditions are met. The Commodity Exchange Act protects whistleblowers’ confidentiality. Whether or not the CFTC issues an award, the agency does not disclose information that could reasonably be expected to reveal a whistleblower’s identity, except in limited circumstances. Consistent with these protections, the CFTC does not disclose the specific enforcement action or the exact award amount. Eligible whistleblowers may receive between 10% and 30% of the monetary sanctions collected. Awards are paid from the CFTC’s Customer Protection Fund, which Congress established and which is funded entirely through monetary sanctions paid to the CFTC by CEA violators. The program is not funded with money taken or withheld from harmed customers. Anyone with information about potential CEA or CFTC violations may submit a tip electronically by filing an online Form TCR (Tip, Complaint, or Referral). Visit Whistleblower.gov for more information about the CFTC’s Whistleblower Program. -CFTC-

items.articleText: 'Biggest U-turn in economic history': Experts react to Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia Nvidia's board members have announced that they unanimously voted to reinstate Jensen Huang as the company's boss "effective immediately" - capping a remarkable U-turn in the technology firm's fortunes. The board had previously ruled out Huang's return after he admitted an affair with a woman who was alleged to be a Chinese spy. US President Donald Trump praised the decision, telling CNBC he made it happen, while Nvidia's share price shot up by more than 30% after a week of poor performance in the wake of the initial scandal. Experts from across the techonology and business sector reacted to his unexpected return.

items.titleTr: Iranian authorities flog singer who performed without hijab, lawyers say
items.summaryTr: Parastoo Ahmadi, three musicians and a producer were reportedly given 74 lashes in Qom.
items.articleText: Iranian authorities flog singer who performed without hijab, lawyers say - Published A prominent singer who performed without the mandatory hijab and four members of her band and production team have been flogged by Iranian authorities, lawyers say. Parastoo Ahmadi, three musicians and a producer were each given 74 lashes in the city of Qom, a member of their defence team told the BBC. Ahmadi, 29, wore a sleeveless dress during a concert that was livestreamed in December 2024. Iran's laws ban public performances by women and require them to wear headscarves and modest clothing. This June, a criminal court in Qom convicted Ahmadi and eight others of "offending public decency" through the publication of "obscene and indecent material", which they had denied. In addition to being sentenced to 74 lashes, they were banned from audiovisual activities and from leaving the country for two years. At the end of September, an appeals court in Qom rejected the defendants' appeal and confirmed the sentence, her lawyers said. There was widespread condemnation of the sentences from other Iranian artists and human rights activists, who warned that flogging constituted cruel, inhuman and degrading punishment, and violated the international prohibition on torture. On Monday, one of the defendants' lawyers told the BBC that Ahmadi and four of her male co-defendants had been flogged at the third branch of the Criminal Sentence Enforcement Office in Qom. "We did everything in our power to have the verdict overturned, or at least to secure a reduction in the sentence or a suspension, but it didn't work out," he said. "The other lawyers and I even tried to get the enforcement of the sentence postponed, but the enforcement branch insisted on carrying it out immediately." Pro-reform daily Etemad cited another defence lawyer, Mostafa Nili, as identifying the four men flogged alongside Ahmadi as Soheil Faghih-Nasiri, Amin Taheri, Amirali Pirnia and Mohsen Lashkari. "Parastoo Ahmadi's flogging for singing and dressing as she chooses is a flagrant violation of her fundamental rights and a chilling demonstration of the Iranian authorities' determination to suppress women's freedoms and to violently punish anyone who dares to challenge their discriminatory laws and policies," said Bahar Ghandehari, director of advocacy at the US-based Center for Human Rights in Iran (CHRI). Under Iranian law, which is based on the country's interpretation of Sharia, women and girls above the age of puberty must cover their hair with a hijab and wear long, loose-fitting clothing to disguise their figures. In 2022, protests swept across the Islamic Republic following the death in custody of Mahsa Amini, a 22-year-old Kurdish woman who was detained by morality police in Tehran in September that year for allegedly wearing her hijab "improperly". Women burnt their headscarves or waved them in the air at the nationwide demonstrations against the clerical establishment, during which hundreds of people were killed in a crackdown by security forces. Since then, many women and girls have stopped covering their hair in public altogether in open defiance of the dress code. Authorities have responded with periodic waves of arrests, warnings, business closures and other measures. In January this year, thousands of people were killed and tens of thousands were arrested when security forces crushed another wave of mass anti-establishment protests, this time sparked by the country's economic crisis. Since the start of Iran's war with the US and Israel in late February, authorities have intensified their use of the death penalty against protesters. According to the Norway-based group Iran Human Rights, at least 39 men convicted over January's protests and two convicted over the 2022 unrest have been executed, along with 16 people allegedly affiliated with banned opposition groups and 17 others convicted of espionage or collaborating with foreign states. Another 121 protesters detained in January, including six women and five juvenile offenders, have been sentenced to death and are at imminent risk of execution, it says. Related topics - Published28 September - Published16 September 2024
